newsitem.title: JAPAN: Chrysler unit to appoint new dealers in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler unit to appoint new dealers in Japan.

text.p: Chrysler Japan Sales Ltd, the exclusive distributor of Chrysler Corp's automobiles in Japan, said on Thursday it would appoint three new main dealers in Japan.
The new dealerships will be in Mie and Ishikawa prefectures in central Japan, and Tokyo's Tama area, the unit said in a statement.
Kusuhara Jidosha KK in Mie, Global Motors Co Ltd in Ishikawa and Daiwa Honda KK in Tama would each form companies to open exclusive showrooms for Chrysler cars, it said.
The unit has been recruiting new dealers to develop a sales network in Japan and has already appointed 14 main dealers in different parts of the country, the unit said.
Robert Bowen, president of Chrysler Japan Sales, said that his unit's top priority was to expand its sales network and increase sales of Chrysler/Jeep products.
"These three new main dealers will bring our products closer to the customers in the regions," he said in a statement.
"Chrysler will continue to make efforts in expanding our business in Japan while providing services and customer satisfaction in the Japanese market," he said.
